newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-REED AND HASTINGS RECALLED TO SCOTLAND SIDE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-REED AND HASTINGS RECALLED TO SCOTLAND SIDE.

text.p: British Lions' lock Andy Reed has been recalled to the Scotland side after a two-year injury absence for the international against Italy on Saturday.
Reed replaces Doddie Weir while Northampton's Matt Stewart wins a first cap at prop.
Scott Hastings, Scotland's most capped player, has been recalled at centre at the expense of Ron Eriksson.

Scotland - Rowen Shepherd; Tony Stanger, Scott Hastings, Gregor Townsend (captain), Kenny Logan; Craig Chalmers, Bryan Redpath; Eric Peters, Ian Smith, Murray Wallace, Damian Cronin, Andy Reed, Matt Stewart, Kevin McKenzie, Dave Hilton.
